```{r setup}
# reset global environment ----
rm(list = ls())

# import packages ----
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
library(ellmer)
library(tigris)
library(stringdist)

```

```{r pa-commenter-data-import}

# import tabula table for pennsylvania house redistricting comments ----
tabulaPAHouse <- read.csv(file = "./Data/TabulaPAHouse.csv") |>
  dplyr::select(-X) |>
  dplyr::rename(CommunityName = "Community.Name") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Description = paste0(CommunityName, ": ", Description),
    Date = lubridate::dmy(x = Date)
  )

```

```{r initialize-chat}

# initialize chat object ----
chat <- ellmer::chat_openai() # model gpt-4.1

```

```{r gather-comment-data}

# compile comment data ----
commentData <- purrr::map2(
  .x = as.character(tabulaPAHouse$Date[1:10]),
  .y = tabulaPAHouse$Description[1:10],
  .f = \(date, description) {
    
    ## pause system to limit token rate ----
    Sys.sleep(time = 10)
    
    ## gather individual comment data and mentioned locations ----
    chatOutput <- chat$chat_structured(
      description,
      type = ellmer::type_object(
    
        ### locations included in the community of interest ----
        LocationsMentioned = ellmer::type_object(
          Location = ellmer::type_array(
            items = ellmer::type_string(),
            description = paste(
              "List of all specific locations that this Pennsylvania commenter mentions,",
              "including landmarks, neighborhoods, townships, boroughs, and counties.",
              "Order locations by their appearance in the comment.",
              "Return only the identifiable, administrative name of the location.",
              "For example, if 'western suburbs of the city of Lancaster' is mentioned,",
              "return only 'City of Lancaster'.",
              "Locations should thus read like the following examples:",
              "Fishtown Neighborhood, State College, Bucks County"
            )
          ),
          LocationDescription = ellmer::type_array(
            items = ellmer::type_string(),
            description = paste(
              "Mentioned areas of each location that this Pennsylvania commenter mentions.",
              "If it can be assumed that all of the location is being mentioned, return 'All'.",
              "Otherwise, return something like 'western suburbs'",
              "if the commenter mentions 'western suburbs of Lancaster.",
              "Order areas by their appearance in the comment."
            )
          ),
          Counties = ellmer::type_array(
            items = ellmer::type_string(),
            description = paste(
              "An estimate of the Pennsylvania counties corresponding to each location",
              "that this Pennsylvania commenter mentions.",
              "Order counties by their appearance in the comment.",
              "Format county names like the following examples:",
              "Centre County, Delaware County, Beaver County"
            )
          )
        ),
        
        ### comment sentiment ----
        commentSentiment = ellmer::type_number(
          description = paste0(
            "Positive/Negative sentiment of this Pennsylvania commenter's description ",
            "of a community of interest scaled from 0 to 1. ",
            "A score of 0 indicates completely negative emotional sentiment, ",
            "while a score of 1 indicates completely positive emotional sentiment."
          )
        ),
        
        ### comment clarity ----
        commentClarity = ellmer::type_number(
          description = paste(
            "Clarity of this Pennsylvania commenter's description",
            "of a community of interest scaled from 0 to 1.",
            "Clarity should be based on how specific the commenter's mentioned",
            "locations are and how clearly they state their desire to include or",
            "exclude those locations from a community of interest.",
            "A score of 0 indicates no clarity,",
            "while a score of 1 indicates complete clarity."
          )
        )
      )
    )
    
    chatOutput$Date <- date
    chatOutput$OriginalComment <- description
    chatOutput$Characters <- nchar(description)
    
    ## return comment information ----
    return(chatOutput)
  }
)

```

```{r match-geonames}

# match geonames to comment data ----
commentData <- commentData |>
  purrr::map(
    .f = \(commentInfo) {
      if (length(commentInfo$LocationsMentioned$Location) > 0) {
        
        ## gather geonames matches for all mentioned locations in a comment ----
        geoNamesMatches <- purrr::map2(
          .x = commentInfo$LocationsMentioned$Location,
          .y = commentInfo$LocationsMentioned$Counties,
          .f = \(location, counties) {
            print(paste("Gathering Matches for", location, "in", counties))
            
            ### assign candidate county fips codes for an individual location ----
            countyFIPSCodes <- tigris::fips_codes |>
              dplyr::filter(state == "PA", county %in% counties) |>
              dplyr::pull(county_code) |>
              as.numeric()
            print(paste("Counties Found:", countyFIPSCodes))
            
            ### filter possible geonames matches to candidate counties ----
            countyGeoNames <- pennsylvaniaGeoNames |>
              dplyr::filter(Admin2Code %in% countyFIPSCodes, FeatureClass %in% c("P", "A"))
            print(paste("Number of Possible GeoNames Matches:", nrow(countyGeoNames)))
            
            ### match location mentions to their closest geonames candidates ----
            geoNames <- countyGeoNames |>
              dplyr::mutate(
                MatchDistance = stringdist::stringdist(
                  a = Name,
                  b = location,
                  method = "jaccard"
                )
              ) |>
              dplyr::slice_min(order_by = MatchDistance) |>
              dplyr::filter(MatchDistance <= 0.3) |>
              dplyr::pull(Name)
            print(paste("Matched GeoNames:", geoNames))
            cat("\n")
            
            ### return geonames location matches ----
            return(geoNames)
          }
        ) |> purrr::list_c()
      } else {
        geoNamesMatches <- character(0)
      }
      
      ## add geonames location matches to comment information ----
      commentInfo$LocationsMentioned$GeoNames <- geoNamesMatches
      
      ## return comment information ----
      return(commentInfo)
    }
  )

```

```{r group-locations}

# group geonames locations into distinct communities of interest ----
commentData <- commentData |>
  purrr::map(
    .f = \(commentInfo) {
      
      ## pause system to limit token rate ----
      Sys.sleep(time = 10)
      
      ## assign community group numbers ----
      if (length(commentInfo$LocationsMentioned$GeoNames) > 0) {
        communityGroups <- chat$chat_structured(
          commentInfo$OriginalComment,
          type = ellmer::type_array(
            items = ellmer::type_integer(),
            description = paste(
              "This Pennsylvania commenter is requesting that certain locations",
              "be grouped into various communities of interest.",
              "Return the group number of each of the following locations",
              "according to the commenter's specifications:",
              paste(commentInfo$LocationsMentioned$GeoNames, collapse = ", ")
            )
          )
        )
      } else {
        communityGroups <- integer(0)
      }
      
      ## add community group numbers to comment information ----
      commentInfo$LocationsMentioned$CommunityGroup <- communityGroups
      
      ## return comment information ----
      return(commentInfo)
    }
  )

```
